artifact_archive.encoding: gzip of JSON mapping original filenames to their exact UTF-8 contents

limits: One fresh-context agent completed seven tasks sequentially in one temporary project; this is not seven independent trials or a general accuracy estimate.
The agent received prompt.txt and project skills, not run.json, expected values or evaluator criteria. The parent reviewed actual answers and durable state after execution.
Preview delivery and declared review are distinct observations; neither proves understanding or human approval.
Impact coverage is limited to discovered subject-related pages. The scenario intentionally authorizes only the primary write; it does not validate autonomous multi-page repair or atomic commits.

The separate deterministic preview regression covers unadopted hand edits and effective-time drift; native host auto-activation, missing-timezone behavior and live multi-page concurrent repair were not independently model-tested.
The stock Python skill validator lacked PyYAML; Ruby YAML frontmatter validation and packaged-skill tests passed instead.
